name: Website Verification
description: Read-only health check of the live tachin.ai website: every page loads, assets resolve, no broken links, design-system stylesheet present. Verifies and reports; never modifies or redeploys.

steps.title: Page reachability check
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Check every page returns HTTP 200 with non-zero content on ${site_url}: index.html, about.html, security.html, privacy.html, terms.html, newly-released.html, styles.css.
steps.accept_criteria: Every page checked; status and size reported.

steps.title: Asset and link integrity
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Fetch each page, extract referenced assets (CSS, images) and internal links, and confirm each resolves to HTTP 200. Report any 404s.
steps.accept_criteria: All referenced assets and internal links resolve, or 404s are listed.

steps.title: Produce verification report
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Produce a HEALTHY / DEGRADED / FAILED report summarizing page status, asset integrity, and any issues found.
steps.accept_criteria: Report produced with an overall verdict and specific findings.
